audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-tempo electronic background music with a steady synthesized beat begins immediately. A group of three male voices shout a rhythmic introduction in unison. (2) Each speaker takes a turn uttering a single word or short phrase with high intensity and sharp articulation, perfectly timed to the music's rhythm. Short 'pop' sound effects punctuate the appearance of visual text. (3) Frequent outbursts of boisterous, high-arousal male laughter erupt between the rhythmic speaking segments, creating a chaotic yet joyful acoustic environment. (4) The vocals maintain a high pitch and excited tone throughout, with the background music consistently driving the energy until a sudden cut-off at the end.
